summary: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE: require a wider minimum band before the grid is built.
assumptions: Fees stay at the operator-attested rate.
suggested_change: Raise the minimum band ratio from 0.02 to 0.03 so that cells clear the fees.
expected_benefit: Fewer fee-negative cycles in the stress scenario.
risk_tradeoffs: Fewer trading windows and lower activity overall.
required_validation: Walk-forward backtest on a frozen snapshot, then a paper run of at least seven days.
rollback_plan: Revert the parameter through a reviewed release and rerun the backtest.
